company.name: Triana Biomedicines
company.shortDescription: Triana Biomedicines is a developer of a molecular glue discovery platform to regulate disease.
company.description: Triana Biomedicines is a developer of a molecular glue discovery platform to regulate disease targets that are difficult to address with any other modality. Triana’s drug discovery engine is powered by high-resolution structural insights, state-of-the-art in silico tools, and bespoke chemical libraries. The research team has validated the best-in-class platform and initiated multiple programs across different disease areas.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that identifies small molecules promoting protein-protein interactions to regulate disease targets, especially for targeted protein degradation in cancer.
productsAndServices.name: Molecular Glue Discovery Platform
